name: Solid-state solar vaccine fridge
subtitle: a silent fridge with no gas or pump

effects.effect: an electric field makes certain thin films heat up or cool down
cheap printable crystals turn sunlight into current almost as well as silicon

effect: an electric field makes certain thin films heat up or cool down
how: Up to half of vaccines in hot countries are spoiled by broken cold chains, and fridge compressors and refrigerant gases fail in remote clinics. Printed perovskite panels on the lid power stacks of thin films that cool down when a voltage is applied, pumping heat out of a well-insulated box with no compressor, gas or moving parts.
obstacle: Electrocaloric coolers are still small lab devices that move only a few watts of heat.
why: Electrocaloric fridges are lab demonstrations; none built for off-grid use.
real: Electrocaloric cooling prototypes exist at lab scale (e.g. 20.9 C span, 4.2 W, Science), and solar vaccine fridges use compressors or thermoelectrics, but no electrocaloric vaccine fridge was found.
